# BO - Order - Invoice / Payment method is not printed on invoice if the order isn't yet paid

The payment method is not printed on the invoice if the order isn't yet paid

## Attendu
The payment method selected during the checkout should be printed on the invoice even if the order isn't yet paid

## Étapes
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to FO and make an order
2. Go to BO => order => order => and select the previously created order
3. Click on the document tab and click on "generate invoice" button
4. Open the invoice and see error => the payment method is not printed on the invoice
